INVOKE. ritual-or-art. Capturing local mystical essence fills a reserve up to 6 that can be spent to create minor mystical effects or illusions, or to Compel through a show of power in its improved form. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

LEECH. ritual-or-art. A blood rune grants a one-time reroll and +2 harm, then converts each harm point inflicted into health or momentum; an improved version can also give remaining points to an ally or companion. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

LIGHTBEARER. ritual-or-art. Capturing light provides a reserve used to improve moves through darkness or to attack dark-dwelling foes by spending light as part of the harm dealt. [verb remove] (batched reader, unchecked)

SHADOW-WALK. ritual-or-art. A shadow veil improves one ambush, hiding, or sneaking move, while its improved form permits travel on shadow-realm paths and doubles progress on a strong journey result at a stress cost. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

SCRY. ritual-or-art. Looking into flames enables observation of a known remote person or place, or a past event in its improved form, with a sacrifice required on a weak hit. [verb sense; also needs future-vision] (batched reader, unchecked)

TALISMAN. ritual-or-art. A charm named for a person or creature improves the wearer’s moves opposing that target, or can instead protect against supernatural threats; a roll of 1 on a move using it expends the magic. [verb law: protect] (batched reader, unchecked)

TETHER. ritual-or-art. Communing with a place’s spirits creates a bond that improves journeys back there and, in an improved form, rerolls during a stay; performing the ritual elsewhere or facing desolation breaks it. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

SWAY. ritual-or-art. Speaking a person’s name to the wind reveals their need and improves a later attempt to Compel them using that information; an improved form can also improve gathering information from them. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)

VISAGE. ritual-or-art. Blood-and-ash face paint improves moves based on fear or intimidation, and its improved form also adds to specified combat moves; a roll of 1 while using it ends the magic. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

TOTEM. ritual-or-art. Focusing on a companion’s totem creates a bond that improves companion abilities, and an improved form lets the user perceive through the companion’s senses even when apart. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

WARD. ritual-or-art. A salt-marked circle creates a boundary with selectable benefits against foes crossing or within it, and its improved form increases those benefits and makes trapping a foe more certain. [verb block; also needs formation-field, containment-rule] (batched reader, unchecked)
